findings.title: L-BFGS-B ftol=1e-6 stop leaves up to 1.2 % objective on two-zone+DHW winter solves
findings.claim: From the shipped x of the two-zone+DHW space solve, an ftol-1e-12 L-BFGS-B polish lowers the captured production objective by a winter mean 0.20 % (max 1.23 %, winter_moderate/winter_cold) against 0.079 % at flat prices, and that gap falls to 0.009 % when production's ftol is set to 1e-10.
findings.mechanism: _multi_start_minimize main run and _lbfgsb_restart both pass ftol 1e-6 to _scoped_minimize; the relative stop ends descent at nit 47-135 while further descent of 0.1-1.3 objective units remains; maxiter is not binding (maxiter 50 and 1000 give identical plans).

evidence.unit: pct (winter mean polish gap, n=8, range 0..1.2344, drop-max mean 0.0551; flat mean 0.0787)
evidence.contention_note: fan-out, two other compute seats; objective ratio is contention-immune

perturbation.expected_direction: down: winter mean polish gap 0.20 % -> 0.009 % measured; shipped objective lower in 7/8 winter cells (mean -0.40 %)

findings.metric_definition: (J(prod.x) - J(L-BFGS-B ftol 1e-12 polish from prod.x)) / |J(prod.x)| on the captured production objective, per two-zone+DHW 24 h cell
findings.phenomenon_property: every production L-BFGS-B call stops on ftol 1e-6 before local convergence of the objective
findings.proposed_fix_scope: tighten ftol (or add a gtol/pgtol-based stop) for space solves, priced against nfev (~2x) and checked under the MPC loop: mpc_mask.py --arm ftol showed realised energy -1.26 % on winter_narrow/cold but +0.80/+1.50 % on moderate/typical cold and +0.65 % at flat, so the one-shot gap is not consistently realised

findings.title: Console-banner version sample in dashboard-card.md is stale (v6.6.8 vs 7.0.0)
findings.claim: docs/dashboard-card.md tells the reader to compare the card's console banner with the installed version and shows the banner as v6.6.8. The doc sample is never re-stamped and drifts with every release.

findings.seam_rule: grep -nE 'v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' README.md docs/*.md, keeping the hits that present a current version rather than a historical one
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Replace the literal with a placeholder (vX.Y.Z), or have stamp.py rewrite the banner sample
